title: Appointment
description: Represents a client appointment for scheduling cleaning services.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client who made the appointment.

siteId.description: Reference to the Site for the appointment.

title.description: Title or brief description of the appointment.

date.description: The date of the appointment (ISO 8601 date string).

startTime.description: Start time of the appointment (ISO 8601 time or datetime string).

endTime.description: End time of the appointment (ISO 8601 time or datetime string).

status.description: The current status of the appointment.

supervisorId.description: Reference to User (Supervisor) assigned to this appointment.

notes.description: Additional notes or special requests for the appointment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
